context.title: Signs of the End
context.summary: On the Mount of Olives, Jesus foretells the temple's destruction, describes coming troubles and the 'abomination of desolation', speaks of the Son of Man's coming, and urges constant readiness since no one knows the day or hour.
context.background: Herod's temple was one of the great buildings of the Roman world; Roman armies destroyed it in AD 70 after a Jewish revolt. Christians read this discourse in different ways: as describing AD 70, the end of the age, or both.

customs.note: A phrase from Daniel that Jews linked with 167 BC, when the Syrian king Antiochus IV set up a pagan altar in the temple.
Roofs were flat living space reached by an outside stair, so someone there could flee without going indoors.

watchFor: The chapter opens with the disciples' two-part question (v. 3).
Warnings about being deceived keep returning (vv. 4–5, 11, 24).
Examples of watchfulness: Noah's day, the thief, the faithful servant (vv. 37–51).

people.name: Jesus
people.also: Immanuel, Emmanuel, Messiah, Shiloh, Christ, Jesus Christ, Messias
people.summary: Anointed, the Greek translation of the Hebrew word rendered “Messiah”, the official title of our Lord, occurring five hundred and fourteen times in the New Testament.

people.name: Daniel
people.summary: Beltis protect the king!, the Chaldee name given to Daniel by Nebuchadnezzar (Dan. 1:7).

people.name: Noah
people.summary: Rest, (Heb. Noah) the grandson of Methuselah (Gen. 5:25-29), who was for two hundred and fifty years contemporary with Adam, and the son of Lamech, who was about fifty years old at the time of Adam’s death.

places.name: mount of Olives
places.summary: So called from the olive trees with which its sides are clothed, is a mountain ridge on the east of Jerusalem (1 Kings 11:7; Ezek. 11:23; Zech. 14:4), from which it is separated by the valley of Kidron.

places.name: Judea
places.summary: After the Captivity this name was applied to the whole of the country west of the Jordan (Hag. 1:1, 14; 2:2).

events.title: Holy Week
events.summary: Passage: Matthew 21:1 – John 20:31. Place: Jerusalem. Lasted about 8 days.

events.title: Olivet Discourse
events.summary: Passage: Matthew 24:1 – Luke 21:36. People: Simon, James, John, Andrew, Jesus. Place: mount of Olives.
